adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transaction ordering issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff, the code first updates the database with `prisma.booking.update()` at line ~89-103 to add new attendees, then later calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` at line ~165. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new guests committed. On retry, the `uniqueGuests` filter at lines ~69-73 will find no unique guests (since they're already in booking.attendees from the first attempt) and throw 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' error. This is a real atomicity/consistency bug where partial failure leaves the system in an inconsistent state.
